reviews.t: Effective, easy to use, great price
reviews.x: I've had this facial brush for a few weeks and have used it about half a dozen times. It definitely loosens dirt from my pores. I also use Biore facial strips once in a while, and now they seem to extract more crud. It's a bit messy to use at the sink since it flings water/soap around (especially on medium and high), so I use it in the shower. The fact that it's waterproof makes it easy to clean after using.  I like that it uses a standard USB charger and you can plug the cord directly into the

I'm a guy, so I'm not using this to remove makeup or anything, but I do like staying clean and trying to keep my skin healthy. I've been using this for a few days now and it works well. I'm no expert on how everyone's face should feel afterwards, but the product is doing what it's supposed to. I've used all three speeds, although high is going to be my standard, and I mostly use the deep cleaning brush head. The head vibrates while you make small circles on your face, so if you can imagine that,
My first one the brush wouldn’t stay on and they sent me a replacement. The 2nd one worked for two months and now it will not charge or turn on???

Was working great in the beginning and I really like it when it does work. However, it never charged in the cradle so I just plug it directly into the brush- no biggie- but now a charge lasts like 2 days and then it’s dead again.
My daughter got it for Christmas and it does not charge well. I should of returned it ASAP but thought we maybe we were not using it correctly. DO not purchase , so bummed and can't return it.

reviews.t: DOA!  (dead on arrival) What a piece of junk!
reviews.x: I happily charged it overnight..... Next morning: nothing, dead! I was super excited about this purchase, BUUUUUUUMMER - DOA!  (dead on arrival) What a piece of junk! It looks great, loved the color and design BUT I DO NOT NEED A DECORATIVE PIECE! Go and look for another facial brush, this one doesn't even worth the waiting. do not buy, move on, again: What a piece of junk! Returning right now

I love this face wash brush so much, it cleans my face so well, and I really enjoy the wash plus massage function, so I ended up buying one for my mom, my mother in law, my sister in law and my niece. Unfortunately mine stopped working after 5 month of day and night use. But Marianne from MiroPure made my warranty replacement process so easy and painless.

I liked this product when i first started using it, my face definitely cleared up! i liked that it came with a rechargeable stand too, but it stopped working after having it for only 4 months. And at one point it would randomly turn on by itself.
The brush heads are so nice. I can't get the cap to stay on the head though.

I'm a former Clarisonic user and wanted something that was less expensive to replace when the batteries inevitably stop re-charging.  So far I'm very happy with this.  I have very sensitive skin, and the brushes are absolutely wonderful, no painful/sandpaper feeling like a lot of the brushes out there.  Does a great job cleaning and my skin seems smoother after using it.  My only complaint is that the the brush sprays soapy water everywhere, especially on the strongest setting, so I'm forced sta

Works flawlessly!! My face has never felt so clean, and it is so easy to use. It's great for my acne, I prefer the silicone attachment the most. I am undergoing hormone treatment and have a thyroid disorder so my skin can be quite a mess, but this has been such a godsend for my blemishes. And as an autistic person, it doesn't feel too rubbery or harsh like a lot of the other ones I've tried too, I can admittedly be very picky about textures. I was surprised how quickly it charges too, I thought

reviews.t: GLAD I BOUGHT IT DONT BELIEV THE BAD REVIEWS
reviews.x: I used to have a clarisonic but it stopped working. I paid $225 for it. It lasted for a long time but after it stopped working I couldn't bring myself to pay that much for one again so I kept looking at other options I read lots of reviews and never chose one. I read alot of reviews on this one and I hesitated to get it but for the price I finally decided to get it. This works just as good as the clarisonic, for all the people that thought the brush was too soft just use it on the highest settin

This was my 3rd facial brush I purchased, all others were good, But this one is really good, Brush is larger, feels  it covers more, just right softness brush to make feel cleaning and massaging at same time. the power is also very good, and once you charge in full, stays on for long time. I took to europe, when I got there it was on full speed. I was a bit confused at the beginning on how to turn it on but read the guide, and was all good. I am not in to writing reviews, But this one is very go

When my Clarisonic bit the dust, I didn't want to spend over $100 on a replacement, so I searched until I found this MiroPure Sonic Rechargeable Facial Brush. LOVE the brushes! They are sectioned so that the brush head follows the contours of your face, unlike the flat brushes of the Clarisonic. It comes with 3 different brushes so you have a variety to choose from. The battery lasts much longer than you need to do your entire face, and it has speed variations as well as function variations. Thi

reviews.t: Great face brush for great price!
reviews.x: After review of all face brushes, I chose the MiroPure Rechargeable Facial Brush based on its reviews and it's affordable price.  After it was charged, I could not get it to turn on, but I re-read the reviews and then pushed the "on" button more firmly.  Yes, it worked!  It works just as expected.  The only drawback is that when I hold the brush against my face, my hand accidentally touches the button that changes the speed.  Remembering to move my hand slightly solved that problem.  I am very h

I absolutely LOVE this device! I use it twice a day and it makes my skincare regimen exciting and even more effective! I love that it comes with a charging cup which I also use to store it once it’s finished charging. It charges quickly and lasts a long time and I love the variety of brush heads which provide a deep clean yet are gentle enough to use over eyelids to remove makeup and over my new nose piercing without snagging or causing pain or irritation. Definitely one of my favorite purchases

reviews.t: Both original item and replacement were defective
reviews.x: I can't honestly speak to the effectiveness or functionality of this product, since both the original AND the replacement cleansing brushes I received were defective. Same problem that many others have posted. Opened and charged exactly as instructed, and the brush would not turn on. Placed back in the charger, and it acted as though it had never been charged, and no amount of charging ever allowed it to turn on.  At least the returns process through Amazon is painless.

When I first got the MiroPure, I left it to charge overnight and was upset when it didn't turn on the next day.  It took me a few moments before I realized you have to hold the button for a few seconds before it switches on.  Another click speeds it up etc and holding the button turns it off again.  It vibrates rather than spins, which I prefer because the cleansing brushes that spin tend to get that inevitable wisp of my hair escaping my clip and tangled it.

reviews.t: Neat item but failed to turn on
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:86a5ba9d96b7802ab1bc7d0b612f8ab0]] It did not charge from the base. After 6 hours charging the light was still blinking. Then I charged it directly without the base and the light stayed on, indicating that it was charged successfully. But it failed the device still did not work. Three stars for quality construction, comfortable to hold, different brush heads that are soft to the touch and a silicon brush head. Neatly packed. It is good if it worked.

reviews.t: It did not work and returned, but customer service is great
reviews.x: I received it dead. I charged it and when the lights turned steady blue I tried to turn it on. It did nothing. Returned and got full refund. Customer service contacted me to apologize for the inconvenience and offered me Amazon gift card as a token of good will to resolve the issue. Changed from 1 star to 3 because of the client services. I would probably buy another one and if I had a problem they would fix it.

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the packaging and will keep the box to store extra heads. I am surper impressed by the apparent quality of the product , it feels to be solidly built. I was happy to find that it was charged and ready to use right out of the box. So I didn't have to wait to test it. I own a facial brush that rotates & it is going in the garbage!  ONE VERY HAPPY CUSTOMER.

reviews.t: Quality Facial Brush that reduces blackheads and dry skin
reviews.x: Great facial cleansing brush. I have used many other brands of facial brushes that either didn’t clean as promised, broke shortly after purchasing, or were just plain ripoffs. The MicroPure Sonic brush cleans my facial pores eliminating most blackheads and dead skin. The battery lasts me a good 2 weeks with daily use! I plan to purchase one  for my wife and have recommended to most of my friends.

My daughter has really bad acne, I’m hoping this helps clear her skin. These brushes are packed in very soft bags and nicely packed there was damage to the box but the product was in perfect condition. I will definitely update her condition after using. Could not add warranty on the miropureco/warranty website, but confirmed with customer service chat rep (very nice) warranty completed.

reviews.t: High school blues and keeping it real
reviews.x: For a daughter that is about to go from 8th grade to high school, the stress is unbelievable. As such so are the facial breakouts. This facial brush is an affordable and effective solution for all of your kids making the transition.  We're looking forward to the next one graduating along with another Micropure brush for them too!  Thanks for making this a great and affordable option!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush cleans effectively, leaving skin feeling clean and helping with acne and blemishes.
A common complaint is that the device stops working or fails to charge after a few months of use.
Several reviewers praise the brush heads, noting they are soft, well-designed, and gentle on sensitive skin.
Some reviewers report receiving replacement units from customer service after their first unit failed.
Some users find the device easy to use and consider it a good value compared to pricier alternatives like Clarisonic.
